details:
On 2026-05-18 all 15 release tags of actions-cool/maintain-one-comment were moved to malicious commits in the same Mini Shai-Hulud operation (attributed to TeamPCP in MAL-2026-4161) that hijacked actions-cool/issues-helper, whose payload steals CI secrets and the workflow token and spreads by committing autostart hooks into the calling repository. Socket reports that all release tags of both actions resolve to malicious content, and that GitHub disabled both repositories on 2026-05-19, re-enabled them on 2026-09-16 with the tags unchanged, and disabled them again on 2026-09-25. Treat any workflow that used this action by tag since 2026-05-18 as compromised; full commit SHAs of releases that predate 2026-05-18 are unaffected and are not listed here. No payload sample has been published for this action specifically.

Affected versions. `versions` lists the 13 fixed release tags and the 15 commits that the 15 moved tags resolved to after the move (the floating tags v2 and v3 are not valid OSV versions, so they are covered by their target commits). The tag-to-commit list below shows which `versions` entries are tags and which are the commits they resolve to. Source: the ecosyste.ms GitHub Actions index, which recorded these 15 tags pointing at commits dated 2026-05-18 (https://packages.ecosyste.ms/registries/github%20actions/packages/actions-cool%2Fmaintain-one-comment). The same index records one more tag, v3.0.0, still pointing at a commit dated 2022-08-01 (de04bd2a3750d86b324829a3ff34d47e48e16f4b); it is not listed as affected because we could not confirm that it was moved. No mapping for this action has been confirmed independently of that index.

Tag -> malicious commit (first 12 characters; full SHAs are in `versions`): v0.0.1-wip 8bb68050bc2a, v1.0.0 7bb44528a086, v1.1.0 cae76b348944, v1.2.0 74b8a9a600da, v1.2.1 d6622cc24151, v2 ef01721dfd04, v2.0.0 99b7f41bf9e1, v2.0.1 cbb2ba52a811, v2.0.2 93ec180e89e8, v3 c43d668894be, v3.1.0 2ab0aa3449ff, v3.1.1 5d844d6b1c6a, v3.2.0 f3593fb4454a, v3.2.1 4a6ac28684e2, v3.3.0 7f6120bb10c8.
